outcome: felt needs (e.g., presence of a relative, prayer hall, pain relief)
cohort: 370 women who delivered at JIPMER (Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education & Research).
finding: 12.7% of women experienced disrespectful behavior and 1.3% experienced physical abuse during labor; more than half desired a prayer hall, complete pain relief, and the presence of a relative.
